name: blendercodex
description: Generate and update Blender .blend deliverables through local background bpy execution, with optional temporary live RPC control.

interface.shortDescription: Generate, inspect, and update Blender models.
interface.longDescription: BlenderCodex supports two routes: create model, where Codex builds a new Blender project from scratch through local background bpy execution; and edit model, where Codex starts the user-specified or currently open .blend project through a temporary in-process RPC bridge for live updates. The bridge is one-shot for that Blender run only and does not install a Blender add-on.
capabilities: Humanoid skeleton templates and gated rig fitting
Heroine-calibrated landmarks and duplicate-safe binding previews
Per-slope Boolean trimming for L-shaped tiled roofs
Distinct door and window opening defaults
Stable model signatures and validation runtime
defaultPrompt: Use $blendercodex to create a new .blend project from my reference.
Use $blendercodex to edit my existing Blender model through the temporary bridge.
Use $model-learning and $workflow-learning to promote my manual Blender correction into a tested executor and focused skill.
Use $humanoid-rigging to recognize a character mesh, confirm joint markers, and fit the standard humanoid skeleton.
Use $architectural-openings to create and apply role-specific door and window openings, then validate and finish without a review pause unless I explicitly request one.
Use $tiled-roof to build and validate an editable tiled-roof system through the reusable runtime.
